name: mjnexus-reader-src-tauri
description: Minimal package.json required by the Android gradle `rust` plugin. The plugin runs `npm run -- tauri android android-studio-script ...` from src-tauri (rootDirRel = ../../../); npm finds this package.json immediately (no walk-up) and invokes the Tauri CLI via absolute path so it does not depend on the shell PATH. The `tauri` script must NOT live at the project root, because a root package.json makes `cargo-tauri` resolve beforeBuildCommand's `../frontend` relative to the project root instead of src-tauri.
